metadata.quantization: simulated quantization: quantize -> dequantize -> BF16 -> F.linear for MoE expert weights; FP32 logits and loss
metadata.experiment: Iteration 10 novel per-channel techniques from 2025-2026 mixed-FP4/FP8 MoE ideas

micromix_threshold.description: MicroMix-style explicit threshold on per-channel mean |output activation| for W2; channels above weight_absmax/(2*6) use FP8, W1 stays FP4.

micromix_threshold_routing.description: MicroMix threshold for W2 only on the top 50% routed experts per layer; colder experts remain all-FP4.

router_affinity_weighted_25pct.description: Router-probability-weighted channel sensitivity with global top-k split at 25% / 25% for W1 and W2.

router_affinity_weighted_w1_4_w2_16.description: Router-probability-weighted channel sensitivity with W1=4% and W2=16% global sort-and-split budgets.

cross_expert_outlier_agreement_5pct.description: Protect W2 channels that land in the top 5% mean-|activation| set for more than half of active experts in a layer; W1 stays FP4.

cross_expert_outlier_10pct.description: Protect W2 channels that land in the top 5% mean-|activation| set for more than a quarter of active experts in a layer; W1 stays FP4.

hessian_normalized_25pct.description: Per-expert normalized Hessian sensitivity with routing-scaled global top-k allocation at 25% / 25%.

hessian_normalized_w1_4_w2_16.description: Per-expert normalized Hessian sensitivity with routing-scaled global top-k allocation at W1=4% and W2=16%.
